# Centifi

> AI-powered expense tracker for iOS and Android. Log expenses by voice, photo, or text. Organize with budgets, categories, and lists.

## What is Centifi?

Centifi is a mobile expense tracking app that makes logging money effortless. Users can capture expenses by speaking naturally ("lunch 12 bucks yesterday"), photographing a receipt, or typing plain text. The app uses AI to parse amounts, dates, and categories automatically.

## Key Features

- **Voice & natural language input**: Log expenses by speaking or typing naturally
- **Receipt scanning**: Capture spending from paper receipts or screenshots
- **Category budgets**: Set monthly spending caps per category with on-device alerts
- **Multi-currency support**: Track expenses in any currency
- **Lists**: Organize expenses into separate lists (trips, home, work)
- **On-device notifications**: Budget alerts run locally — no cloud push required
- **Bank hints**: Optional automation from notification text, privacy-first

## Company

Centifi is an independent app focused on privacy-first, on-device expense tracking. The marketing website and the app are separate — the website is informational only.
